summary: The comment opposes any rule changes that would reduce E‑Rate support or infringe parental rights.

claims.requested_action: maintain current level of E‑Rate support
claims.argument: E‑Rate must continue to provide at least the support it is currently providing to serve its intended purpose.
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate is serving its intended purpose and must continue to do so at a minimum of the support it is currently providing. These proposed rule changes would have a negative impact on the public good

claims.requested_action: preserve parental rights in E‑Rate decisions
claims.argument: Rule changes would take away parental rights beyond the duty of the FCC.
claims.evidence_quote: ave a negative impact on the public good and would take away parental rights beyond the duty of the FCC.
